maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from retail sales of secondhand clothing and household goods to consumers, which are first-time purchases, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Thrift store shoppers, who are consumers, pay for the secondhand clothing and goods sold in its stores.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by opening its own thrift stores and selling more secondhand goods, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to other thrift or retail stores; the goods are discretionary, with no switching cost.
